title: Complete production read-only getStatus transport and make Home account rail follow owned running instances

productionTransport.controlPipePath: rebuild host computes the recovered per-user named-pipe path and passes it through the same-session helper control boundary
productionTransport.framing: version-1 JSON envelope over 4-byte little-endian length-prefixed frames
productionTransport.ioPolicy: single background pipe I/O loop; PeekNamedPipe gates complete inbound frames while outbound mailbox frames are serviced on the same thread
productionTransport.luaHandler: exact allowlisted getStatus request/result path only; generic call_lua remains fail-closed

homeUi.implementationPolicy: The Home account rail represents LWBridge-owned running instances only. Active means profile_instance_status has both a non-null pid and a non-empty instanceId; unmanaged games therefore cannot enter the active rail.
homeUi.autoSelection: If the currently selected configured profile is not in the active owned set and another owned running profile exists, select the first active profile so the existing detail loaders target a live account.
homeUi.stopBinding: The active row Stop action passes the exact polled instanceId to profile_instance_stop.
homeUi.browserScopeLimit: The two-profile browser proof is deterministic fixture coverage of generated UI selection/rendering. Real-game transport and Stop are proven separately by the live A11 proof; simultaneous multi-account real-game UI population was not exercised in this checkpoint.

remainingBoundary: A11 read-only transport and the reported Home active-list/right-pane selection path are implemented and proven at the scopes above. The final all-feature release walkthrough and unrelated Map Data population/action gates remain separate acceptance work.
